# Desk (`desk` v1)

A trading desk: books, limits and risk results.

**Group:** Organisation · **Mnemonic:** `DESK` · **Identifiers:** `DESK-…` in `deskId`

Open one with `DESK <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: desk
version: 1
description: "A trading desk: books, limits and risk results."
match: { kind: desk, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Organisation · Desk, id: $.deskId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Head, bind: $.head }
  - { label: Books, bind: size($.books) }
  - { label: VaR, bind: $.var99, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: MTM, bind: $.mtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
panels:
  - id: books
    kind: table
    title: Books
    key: F2
    rows: $.books
    columns:
      - { label: Book, bind: "@.id" }
      - { label: Trades, bind: "@.trades", fmt: amount0, total: true }
      - { label: MTM, bind: "@.mtm", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
